answer: Accredited pharmacist prescription record with pharmacists certification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 404 aliases would need 404 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the raven here is verification, the terrace of cost is what stops the farm, and the copper of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
